title: meta: a pending draft has no untranslated, author-owned read; Studio re-opens its object draft translated and governed
body:
domain:ui#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUJ19MstFvFhjgiYTu

立卡门类别: ① 产品缺陷 — 具名落点. Blocking finding of #29793 (card step 4/5: "if no untranslated read exists, that is a server-side card first"). The card thread measured it on `origin/main` `b62463f1` by reading the code (full notes: claim 6596634127, card thread report). Reader: `domain:server`.

**Business reason.** A tenant author with the console in Chinese (or any non-English locale) edits an object in Studio. Studio autosaves the edit as a draft, and from then on it re-opens and re-PUTs the draft as the server served it, which is translated and carries the platform-injected columns (`owner_id`, `queue`, ...). The author's own labels are replaced by translations, and the platform's columns are sent back as author fields. #29673 (PR #29790) makes the write door repair some of this. Slots the door does not compare (list-view labels, validation messages) are stored translated.

**Measured (code read, `b62463f1`).**
- Studio's object editor (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx:8004-8039`) and Setup's (`views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx:1348-1400`) build the edit buffer as `draft ?? layers.effective ?? layers.code`. The draft comes from `GET /api/v1/meta/object/X?state=draft&package=P`.
- That item read, `?state=draft` included, goes through `createMetaItemAnswer` (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts:3903`), which translates unconditionally. The runtime dispatcher does the same (`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts:736-742`). The draft body is also governed, with injected columns added (`metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-reads.ts:117-124`).
- `metaRequestLocale` (`meta-item-read-gate.ts:2826`) falls back from `Accept-Language` to `?locale=` and then to the i18n default locale. Leaving out the header still answers translated, and there is no opt-out.
- `GET /meta/object/X/layers` (`rest-server.ts:4305`, runtime `domains/meta.ts:902`) is untranslated and raw for `code` and `overlay`, but it serves published layers only, with no draft layer.

So the published document has an author-owned read (`/layers` `overlay ?? code`), and a pending draft has none.

## Wanted

1. An untranslated, ungoverned read of a pending draft body, as authored. Any of these would do: a `draft` member on the `/layers` answer, or an explicit switch on `?state=draft` that skips translation and governance. Name the shape by route and code site, at the REST route and in the runtime dispatcher.
2. Pin it: a zh-CN request of the new read returns the stored draft byte for byte (source labels, no injected columns), and the existing translated `?state=draft` read is unchanged.
3. Once it lands, #29793 (ui) moves the Studio and Setup edit buffers onto it.

**Level:** a new read member or switch is a widening of the meta REST surface. Expect `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, whose protocol level is the server seat's call.

Related: #29793 (blocked by this), #29673 / PR #29790 (the write door).
